links.comparator_used: Zero-shot inference without retrieved evidence (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Cross-model decision dispersion (entropy), robustness of correctness across models, and majority consensus on 169 radiology questions across 34 LLMs
links.effect: Median entropy 0.48 vs. 0.13; mean robustness of correctness 0.74 vs. 0.81; majority consensus increased overall (P<0.001)
links.tradeoff: High agreement did not guarantee correctness; 572 incorrect outputs, 72% rated moderate or high clinical severity (inter-rater kappa=0.02)
links.quote: Agentic inference reduced inter-model decision dispersion (median entropy 0.48 vs. 0.13) and increased robustness of correctness across models (mean 0.74 vs. 0.81).
